description: Permanently deletes a lead from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

lead_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead to delete.
lead_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the lead you want to delete. You can copy it from the lead's URL or from a previous search or list operation.
lead_id.title: Lead Id

name: delete_lead

DeleteLeadResponse.description:
Response schema for Salesforce DELETE Lead operation.

On success (HTTP 204), the response body is empty (no fields returned).
On error (4xx/5xx), Salesforce returns an array of error objects, but those
are handled by raise_for_status() before reaching this schema.
DeleteLeadResponse.title: DeleteLeadResponse
